messages:
maria: quick RFC — I prototyped a 'preflight' step for deploy-bot + a central templates library (infra/deploy/templates). goal: catch pin issues, lint deploy templates, and verify rollback artifacts before we start canaries. saving PR for feedback.
kevin: :eyes: preflight = what checks exactly? does it touch prod configs or only simulate?

maria: only read-only checks + simulated scheduling. current checks: 1) yaml/schema lint 2) verify model/image pins exist in catalog 3) rollback artifact presence 4) change-window overlap detection 5) canary slot allocation simulation. example command:

```
/deploy preflight --template=infra/deploy/templates/bluegreen.yaml --model-pin=redwood-v2.1 --dry-run
```

deploy-bot: Preflight queued by maria. Running: lint -> pin-check -> rollback-check -> window-check -> canary-sim. Estimated time: ~10s.

rachel: nice. can we also generate a release_notes skeleton from the template so PMs can fill it quickly?

maria: added release_notes.md.j2 template to the library. sample frontmatter I used:

```
release: "{{version}}"
date: "{{date}}"
highlights:
  - "short summary"
rollout:
  strategy: bluegreen
  canary_windows:
    - "23:00-03:00"
```

tim: will preflight run automatically on infra PRs or only manual?

maria: CI hook added in the PR — it runs on PRs that touch infra/deploy or templates. manual /deploy preflight is allowed for ad-hoc checks.

olivia: make sure the pin-check verifies availability across regions (we had a miss last month where a pinned model wasn't in eu-west).

maria: good call. added cross-region catalog lookup. if a pin isn't available in requested region, preflight fails with suggestions (auto-pin to closest compatible).

kevin: what's the rollback-check do? check that previous image/model and config artifacts exist in artifact-store?

maria: yep — looks for last 3 successful deploy artifacts and validates they can be referenced by rollback command. also warns if any recent rollbacks were manual-only (no automated route).

sre-bot: alert if preflight finds missing rollback artifacts: will open incident ticket template /incidents/new if run=true.

kevin: can we have a lint rule to ban manual-edit of production templates without a safety window tag? e.g., require "change_window" field on templates that touch production routes.

maria: implemented as rule DEPLOY-02. PR will fail lint if change_window missing or broader than allowed.

olivia: what about /deploy dry-run output format — can it produce a human-readable checklist we can paste into #incidents when something goes wrong?

maria: yes — dry-run supports --report=json|md. md is the checklist. example:

```
/deploy preflight --template=infra/deploy/templates/bluegreen.yaml --report=md
```

Output attaches a checklist with links to artifact keys and suggested rollback CLI.

kevin: love it. timeline?

maria: opening PR in ~30m. will add README + quickstart and a small deploy-bot command spec. PR link when available.

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/782 by maria — includes preflight, templates library, and CI hook.

kevin: :shipit: will review this afternoon. please include a tiny example of migrating an existing deploy to the new template in the README.

maria: yes — will add migration steps and a script: `scripts/migrate-deploy-to-template.sh` in the PR. thanks all!
